Container.Name: lite-tv
Container.Overview: A fast Jellyfin interface for old LG TVs (2015 onwards, built for webOS 3.x). The pages are built on the server, so the TV's browser has very little to do. Playback uses the official Jellyfin web client's device profile and bitrate test. Open http://[your server]:6972 in the TV's browser and sign in with Quick Connect.

Config.Name: Jellyfin URL
Config.Description: Your Jellyfin server as this container reaches it, for example http://192.168.1.10:8096. Use the server's IP address, not localhost.

Config.Name: Full Jellyfin link
Config.Description: Optional: adds a 'Full Jellyfin' link to the header.

Config.Name: Sign-ins
Config.Description: Where sign-ins are stored. Contains Jellyfin access tokens.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID lite-tv runs as (99 = nobody).

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID lite-tv runs as (100 = users).
